# Veyvox 1.17.14

## Entorpecido guide polish

- Moves the Entorpecido card out of the generic specials strip and into the
  special-cards guide section, alongside the memory card. The section only
  appears when the deck actually supports memory or Entorpecido, and the
  in-guide navigation skips it otherwise.
- Normalizes the Entorpecido artwork framing and manifest/README so the card
  renders with the same framing as the rest of the deck.
- Limits the intoxication blur to the card artwork itself instead of the whole
  card surface, keeping the rules text and layout readable while the effect
  is active.

## Upgrade notice

**Back up the database and uploads before upgrading.** This is a web-only
polish release with no new database migrations. To roll back, stop the
application and restore the matching pre-upgrade backup; do not run an older
server against a migrated database. Desktop signing/platform limitations
remain unchanged. Publishing this release does not itself deploy it.

## Português (Brasil)

A 1.17.14 organiza o guia do Juno: a carta **Entorpecido** sai da faixa
genérica e vai para a seção de cartas especiais, junto da carta de memória.
A moldura da arte foi normalizada e o blur de intoxicação agora afeta só a
arte da carta, mantendo o texto legível. Sem novas migrações de banco.

**Faça backup do banco e dos uploads antes de atualizar.**
